The '''Seswenna Expansion''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that connected [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] to [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]].

==Astrography==
The Seswenna Expansion connected the [[Dustig sector/Legends|Dustig]], [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani]], [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna]] and [[Mayagil sector/Legends|Mayagil]] [[Sector/Legends|sectors]]. This [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] began at [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], passed through [[Darkknell/Legends|Darkknell]] and [[Seswenna/Legends|Seswenna]], and ended at [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]]. It intersected the [[Dustig Trace]] at Malastare, the [[Duros Space Run]] at Darkknell, and the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] at Clak'dor VII.<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
The Seswenna Expansion was charted between [[3701 BBY]] and [[3699 BBY]] by the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] [[Thoax Osaax]] and [[Farge Osaax]], while their rival [[Freia Kallea/Legends|Freia Kallea]] was stranded on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nuvar]]. The Neimoidians charted the route from Malastare and reached the Rimma Trade Route at Clak'dor VII, south of [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Seswenna Expansion would eventually be integrated into a [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]].<ref name="TEA" /> However, over [[Time/Legends|time]], many [[Merchant/Legends|traders]] traveling down the Hydian Way chose to deviate from the route in favor of the loop known as the [[Eriadu Way|Eriadu Bypass]],<ref name="GATORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> and by [[1004 BBY]], the Hydian Way had shifted to run through Eriadu instead of Seswenna.<ref name="TEA" />
